_comment: JSON has no comment syntax, so the rationale lives in this key. tsc ignores unknown top-level keys.
DOM is added here and ONLY here. tsconfig.base.json stays DOM-free so browser globals never leak into the Fastify package. Note `lib` REPLACES the inherited value, so ES2023 must be restated.

Full strictness is retained — no compiler option is relaxed. @irp/client's generated runtime does violate exactOptionalPropertyTypes, but this project resolves that package's TYPES from its emitted dist/*.d.ts (via the `types` export condition) rather than its raw src/*.ts, and the inherited skipLibCheck exempts declarations. The relaxation stays inside packages/client where the generated code lives. See packages/client/tsconfig.build.json for the full reasoning.
